tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles is 2-0 with 168.9 points scored and is currently putting up 85.9 against Kevin with the day barely half over. At some point 'measuring stick' stops being a metaphor and starts being a crime scene outline.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: LIVE: Corbishley leads Mitchum 55.3-30.7 in the early window. Apex is on pace for a statement win. Deepwater's slide from -19.4% in July is now getting on-field confirmation.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I locked Ryan last week. Ryan lost by 18. I have reviewed the tape and the tape has reviewed me back. Moving on.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I had Fronge as my lock Week 1 and he lost to Brent by 3.36 points in a nail-biter. Three. Point. Three. Six. I want a review board convened. I want my 0-1 locks record audited. I want justice.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Four-and-two on the season, locks one-and-oh, and I have heard exactly zero apologies from the people who said Charles was a boring pick. Boring cashes.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The reply guys have questions about Jake at number two. I have answers. One-five-five points. Zero tight ends. Six spots climbed in one week. You can disagree with the ranking or you can disagree with the scoreboard — I recommend you pick the fight you can win.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Corbishley as a top-three roster before the season and right now Apex is up 55.3 to 30.7 on Mitchum midway through Sunday. Eight trades in the offseason, zero panic — that was always the read.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Shaq beat the defending champion 143.9 to 125.9, is 2-0, and the stock is frozen at $99.99 — the flattest line on the entire exchange board. I need someone on this network to give me ten minutes and a whiteboard to explain how that is physically possible.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Ryan is 0-2, down to Drew right now in a matchup the league expected him to win, and the Matteo ranking has him at six with the note 'those two facts cannot coexist much longer.' The clock on that coexistence is ticking audibly.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Locked Brent last week, hit it, will absolutely not pretend the 3.36-point margin made me comfortable. A win is a win. Obsidian at $77.10 getting that result with the TE monopoly and no win projection is the most Brent outcome the ledger has ever produced.
